_meta.title: Amazon Restricted Categories & Required Certificates
important_notes: Amazon does NOT publish a single official machine-readable list. This data is compiled from Amazon Seller Central documentation, official help pages, and verified third-party sources (Jungle Scout, Red Stag Fulfillment, eCom Gliders — all cross-referenced).
Requirements change frequently. Always verify current requirements in Seller Central > Add a Product > Show Limitations before sourcing inventory.
Category approvals are marketplace-specific (US approval does NOT carry over to UK, DE, etc.).
Sub-category gating is MIXED: some root categories gate the whole tree, others gate individual sub-categories independently. See 'subcategory_gating' field per entry.
Beyond categories, Amazon also gates individual BRANDS and ASINs regardless of category approval.

subcategory_gating_legend.root_only: Approval at root level unlocks all sub-categories automatically
subcategory_gating_legend.independent: Sub-categories each require their own separate approval
subcategory_gating_legend.mixed: Root approval covers most sub-categories, but certain sub-categories require additional or separate approval
subcategory_gating_legend.seasonal: Gating rules change during peak seasons (Q4 holiday period)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Root category requires approval. Sub-categories involving safety systems (brakes, suspension, helmets) require additional individual approval.
required_documents: Invoices from authorized automotive distributors (dated within 180 days)
DOT (Department of Transportation) compliance proof where applicable
SAE (Society of Automotive Engineers) compliance documentation where applicable
Professional installation disclaimers for certain performance parts

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: A 'Premium Beauty' sub-category exists with stricter requirements than standard Beauty. Approval for Premium covers standard, but not vice versa. Some ingredient-specific sub-categories (e.g., hydroquinone products) have independent gating.
required_documents: Invoices from authorized beauty distributors (min. 10 units)
Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS) for applicable ingredients
FDA facility registration number (if manufacturing in US)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Sub-categories for children under 3 have the strictest testing requirements. Toys & Games root category has additional seasonal gating (holiday Q4 restrictions for new sellers). Each children's product type may require its own CPC.
required_documents: Children's Product Certificate (CPC) — mandatory for all products for children under 12
Phthalates test report for soft plastic components
certifications: CPC (Children's Product Certificate) — must include: product ID, CPSC rule citation, manufacturer details, records contact, manufacturing info, testing info, accredited lab details
CPSIA compliance (Consumer Product Safety Improvement Act)
common_rejection_reasons: Products not meeting age-appropriate safety standards

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Root approval generally covers the category. High-value items may trigger additional appraisal requirements at the individual listing level.
certifications: Third-party authentication (e.g., PSA, CGC for relevant items)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Each supplement sub-type (weight loss, sports nutrition, herbal, vitamins, etc.) may require independent review. Products making disease claims are effectively prohibited regardless of approval.
required_documents: Certificate of Analysis (CoA) from ISO/IEC 17025 accredited laboratory (issued within last 6 months)
Invoices from authorized supplement distributors (min. 10 units, dated within 180 days)
Label review for FDA Supplement Facts panel compliance
730 days minimum shelf life upon FBA arrival
common_rejection_reasons: Disease or drug claims on labeling

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: General accessories may be ungated for established accounts. Items with lithium batteries, wireless functionality, or electrical mains connection require individual sub-category approval.
required_documents: FCC ID number for wireless products
UL listing certificate for mains-powered electrical items
UN 38.3 transport test for lithium battery products
MSDS/SDS for products with hazmat classification
common_rejection_reasons: Missing FCC ID for wireless products
No UL listing for electrical items

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Root approval covers the category. High-value pieces or works by contemporary living artists may require additional documentation at listing level.
This category is effectively CLOSED to third-party sellers. Only Amazon and specifically authorized partners may sell gift cards. There is no standard application pathway.
required_documents: Direct partnership agreement with Amazon (no standard application pathway)
certifications: N/A — closed category for general sellers
common_rejection_reasons: Category is closed to third-party sellers without a direct Amazon partnership agreement

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Standard packaged food is the root. Organic, alcohol, perishable, and imported food sub-categories each require their own separate approvals.
required_documents: Minimum 50 days remaining shelf life on FBA arrival

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: OTC medications, medical devices, and personal health equipment each operate as independently gated sub-categories. Diagnostic devices (blood pressure monitors, thermometers) require separate approvals from general health items.
required_documents: FDA 510(k) clearance or exemption documentation (for medical devices)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: General lab equipment may be open. Hazardous chemical reagents, controlled substances, and precision instruments requiring licensing are independently gated sub-categories.
Standard fashion jewelry approval covers most of the category. Fine jewelry (precious metals/stones), children's jewelry, and certified pre-owned jewelry are independently gated.
required_documents: Lead testing results (especially for children's jewelry)
certifications: Third-party gemstone authentication (GIA, AGS, etc.) for fine jewelry
common_rejection_reasons: Missing lead testing for children's items

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Each device class is independently gated. Class I (basic) may auto-approve for established accounts. Class II and Class III require extensive individual documentation.
required_documents: FDA PMA (Premarket Approval) for Class III devices
certifications: UL or ETL listing for powered devices

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Collectible music (vinyl, signed items) is gated at root level. Standard new music releases are generally open.
certifications: Third-party authentication for high-value signed items

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Every individual pesticide product requires its own EPA registration. Sub-categories (insecticides, herbicides, rodenticides, devices) are independently gated. This is one of the strictest categories.
certifications: EPA Registration (FIFRA — Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act)
common_rejection_reasons: Products not registered for the intended use

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Root approval covers the main category. High-value game-used items or memorabilia from specific leagues may require additional authentication.
required_documents: Proof of authenticity (COA from recognized authenticator)
certifications: COA from recognized authentication services (PSA, JSA, Beckett, etc.)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Approval is required to sell all streaming devices. Amazon restricts this heavily to protect its own devices and prevent counterfeit listings.
required_documents: Brand authorization letter (if reselling third-party brands)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: The entire category is heavily restricted or prohibited in most cases. Tobacco products themselves are prohibited for sale to general marketplace sellers. Only select accessories may be approved.
common_rejection_reasons: Tobacco products are largely prohibited on Amazon for third-party sellers

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Gated primarily to prevent counterfeit media. Used DVDs are extremely difficult to get approved for. New, sealed product from authorized distributors is the viable path.
required_documents: Invoices from authorized distributors showing NEW items
Minimum 3 invoices covering at least 30 units
certifications: N/A — documentation-based approval, no specific certifications required

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Standard watches and luxury/fine watches are separate sub-categories with different requirements. Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) watches require independent approval.
required_documents: Professional seller account in good standing
For CPO watches: water resistance test results, timekeeping accuracy certification from third-party watchmaker
Seller performance metrics meeting Amazon minimums
certifications: Brand authorization for luxury brands (e.g., Rolex, TAG Heuer require direct brand authorization)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Alcohol is among the most restricted categories. Each alcohol type may require separate approval. Availability is limited to specific US states with compliant regulations. Access is largely by invitation only.
required_documents: Direct invitation from Amazon (most common entry path)
certifications: TTB Basic Permit (Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau)

gated_categories.subcategory_notes: Hazmat status is product-level, not purely category-level. Products across many categories can be flagged as Hazmat. Each hazmat product requires individual compliance. This is a cross-cutting gating type, not a standalone browsing category.
required_documents: Exemption documentation if claiming de minimis quantities

ungated_categories_with_gated_subcategor.note: Generally open, but specific publishers and used books from certain brands now require approval. New sellers may find Books gated at account level until they meet performance thresholds.
Generally open. Some electrical appliances sub-categories require FCC/UL documentation.
Generally open outside Q4. Holiday season (October–December) adds gating for new/low-volume sellers. Children's toys (under 12) are gated under Children's Products rules.
Generally open. Certain brands are gated. Counterfeit-prone luxury brands require LOA (Letter of Authorization).
Generally open. Safety equipment (helmets, harnesses) and sports collectibles are gated sub-categories.

universal_documents_required_across_all_: Professional Amazon Seller Account in good standing
Invoices from legitimate manufacturer or licensed distributor (typically 3 invoices, 30+ units total, dated within 180 days)
Your business name and address visible on invoices
Supplier name and address visible on invoices
Product images (all sides, labels legible, white background preferred)
Seller performance metrics meeting Amazon minimums
